subject: Request: route-level cost & tail-latency slicing playbook for GreenWave
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Liu <jason@greenwave.io>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: route-level cost & tail-latency slicing playbook for GreenWave

Hi Aditya and Lauren,

Following up from our customer call this morning with GreenWave — they want more transparent, per-route costing and a way to slice latency tails by customer route so they can validate their SLAs at the feature level. Jason asked specifically for: 90/95/99p latency percentiles per route (30d), token-based cost breakdown (inferred vs generation) per route, and the ability to quickly filter by model variant and region.

Quick background: GreenWave is sizing for a pilot (GW-2026-024) and procurement wants to see a short operational playbook showing how we'd detect a cost/regression spike for a route and the automated/manual remediation steps. They also sent their mutual action plan (attached).

Can product/console team provide: 
- A short playbook (1–2 pages) we can share with procurement that shows alerting thresholds, sample queries, and a remediation runbook for a route-level SLA breach.
- Example dashboard snapshots or a mock that shows per-route cost and latency percentiles.
- Any known limitations (e.g., sampling windows, cardinality caps, data latency) and expected ETA for changes.

Attachments: GW-MAP-v1.xlsx, route-slice-sample.csv (sample of GreenWave route names)

Would appreciate a quick sync or an internal note I can forward to Jason by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: route-level cost & tail-latency slicing playbook for GreenWave

Thanks Monica — good summary. A few clarifying points before we draft a playbook: 

1) "Per-route" definitions: does GreenWave consider a route to be API path + model id + tenant id, or is it more coarse (API path only)? The sample CSV helps but I want to confirm cardinality expectations.
2) Cost breakdown: we currently attribute tokens to routes at the request header level; for batched requests or shared model instances there are edge cases (small cross-route attribution noise). Is that OK to call out?
3) Latency tails: our observability pipeline gives 50/95/99p for request-to-first-byte and request-to-last-byte, but percentile accuracy depends on sampling config. For a 30d window we recommend 10k samples per route for stable 99p.

I can put together a 1.5–2 page draft playbook and a mock dashboard today — will attach a short slide with sample queries and the expected data freshness (typically 5–10 minutes for metrics, 1–2 hours for cost rollups in the current console).

Proposed next steps: 
- I’ll draft the playbook and a mock dashboard (OBS-478).
- Lauren — can you sync on the procurement/CS ask for wording? Monica, is EOD Monday still OK to share the draft with GreenWave?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior PM, Console & Observability
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Jason Liu <jason@greenwave.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, GreenWave Analytics SOC Team <security@greenwave.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: route-level cost & tail-latency slicing playbook for GreenWave

Monica — thanks for initiating. A few notes from our side that will determine whether this is a procurement "must-have" vs. a "nice to have":

- Route identity: we define a route as tenant_id + api_path + model_tag. We have ~2.5k active routes but only expect 150–200 steady routes during pilot.
- Alerting: we need a sample alert that triggers on 99p latency > 1.5s for 10 minutes or cost/spend on a route rising >25% week-over-week. The playbook should show where that alert ties into the console (route page) and what automated fallbacks exist (model variant routing, capacity shift).
- Compliance: SOC wants to understand data retention for route-level logs and whether route metadata will contain PII — cc’ing security.

Happy to review a draft playbook and test the mock dashboard. Monday EOD is fine.

Thanks,
Jason Liu
Head of Platform Engineering
GreenWave Analytics
jason@greenwave.io

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Jason Liu <jason@greenwave.io>, GreenWave Analytics SOC Team <security@greenwave.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: route-level cost & tail-latency slicing playbook for GreenWave

Copying progress and next steps: 

- Draft playbook attached (playbook-draft.docx) — 2 pages. It contains: detection triggers, short remediation runbook (automated fallback, pin to cheaper quantized variant, temporary throttling), and suggested thresholds (we used Jason’s 99p > 1.5s and 25% WoW spend delta).
- Mock dashboard: attached screenshots are in the DRIVE link; I'll upload a static PNG to OBS-478.
- Limitations: current console can slice per-route at up to ~5k unique route keys per org before we recommend cardinality bucketing; cost rollups are computed hourly for runs >24h (we've noted this in the doc).
- Compliance note: route metadata will not contain raw PII by default; we recommend customers hash any tenant-specific identifiers before sending. Jason, @security — happy to run through the retention settings offline.

Monica — feel free to forward the attached playbook and DRIVE link to GreenWave. Aditya and I will create an internal RFC to propose a UI tweak for a per-route "view" card (OBS-478) that exposes the percentile chart and cost breakdown.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
